{{Quote|Covert surveillance. Watching Morbo. Part of Operation Transom.|A [[Unidentified Houk agent|Houk SIS agent]]|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
'''Operation Transom''' was a joint mission of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] and [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] that was conducted during the [[Galactic War]] era. Its goal was to free captured [[Republic trooper]]s who were being sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The mission was under the direct supervision of [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS Director]] [[Marcus Trant]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] successfully freed soldiers being sold by the [[Hutt/Legends|hutt]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Morbo]], however his actions caused the long-term SIS operation to fall apart.<ref name="Annihilation" />
